name: cargo_demand_fulfillment
formula: sum(cargo_tons over legs serving a port) >= demand_target[port]
data_source: cargo_demand_derived.csv (real annual Indian port traffic used as an illustrative demand target)

name: vessel_availability_eligibility
formula: vessel_class in AVAILABLE_CLASSES (all 4 observed classes assumed always available)

name: route_feasibility
formula: route in route_derived.csv (real port-pair rows only)

name: voyage_deadline
data_source: route_derived.csv distance_nm (DERIVED); deadline_hours = SCENARIO_VOYAGE_DEADLINE_MULTIPLIER * nominal voyage time

name: draft_vs_port_depth
data_source: port_master_derived.csv has no physical depth in metres (only lat/lon)
status: UNAVAILABLE (checker reports UNAVAILABLE, never fabricates pass/fail)

name: port_capacity
data_source: no rated port throughput capacity exists in processed data

name: fuel_availability
data_source: data_layer.py SCENARIO_PORT_FUEL_AVAILABILITY (assumed both fuels available everywhere)
